name: When They Came For Us
summary: Engage in an extraterrestrial experience. Aliens have come to Earth and have taken you and others captive. When They Came For Us is the first interactive VR experience that allows you to have a conversation with an alien. A conversation that will challenge many things you have taken for granted. But this conversation will also decide about your freedom: Will you manage to convince the alien life form to release you? Or will you remain at its mercy, to be used as it pleases?
